learnings: Models may hallucinate that official alternative domains (like 'pypi.io' for PyPI) are typosquats. The audit tool should maintain a whitelist of known official alternative domains for common ecosystems (e.g., pypi.io, github.io, readthedocs.io) to prevent false positives.
